mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project ( project_id, serial_number, title, description, category_id, tags, requirements, skill_level, team_size_min, team_size_max, duration_days, budget_type, budget_amount, currency, published_at, submitted_at, application_deadline, expected_start_date, expected_end_date, status, reject_reason, progress, publisher_id, accepted_team_id, application_count, view_count, favorite_count, create_time, update_time, version ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{serialNumber}, #{title}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{tags}, #{requirements}, #{skillLevel}, #{teamSizeMin}, #{teamSizeMax}, #{durationDays}, #{budgetType}, #{budgetAmount}, #{currency}, #{publishedAt}, #{submittedAt}, #{applicationDeadline}, #{expectedStartDate}, #{expectedEndDate}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{progress}, #{publisherId}, #{acceptedTeamId}, #{applicationCount}, #{viewCount}, #{favoriteCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET serial_number = #{serialNumber}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, tags = #{tags}, requirements = #{requirements}, skill_level = #{skillLevel}, team_size_min = #{teamSizeMin}, team_size_max = #{teamSizeMax}, duration_days = #{durationDays}, budget_type = #{budgetType}, budget_amount = #{budgetAmount}, currency = #{currency}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, application_deadline = #{applicationDeadline}, expected_start_date = #{expectedStartDate}, expected_end_date = #{expectedEndDate}, status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, progress = #{progress}, accepted_team_id = #{acceptedTeamId}, application_count = #{applicationCount}, view_count = #{viewCount}, favorite_count = #{favoriteCount}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = #{version} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.project_id, p.serial_number, p.title, p.description, p.category_id, p.tags, p.requirements, p.skill_level, p.team_size_min, p.team_size_max, p.duration_days, p.budget_type, p.budget_amount, p.currency, p.published_at, p.submitted_at, p.application_deadline, p.expected_start_date, p.expected_end_date, p.status, p.reject_reason, p.progress, p.publisher_id, p.accepted_team_id, p.application_count, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.version, u.nickname AS publisher_name, t.team_name AS accepted_team_name FROM project p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.publisher_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN team t ON p.accepted_team_id = t.team_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT p.id, p.project_id, p.serial_number, p.title, p.description, p.category_id, p.tags, p.requirements, p.skill_level, p.team_size_min, p.team_size_max, p.duration_days, p.budget_type, p.budget_amount, p.currency, p.published_at, p.application_deadline, p.expected_start_date, p.expected_end_date, p.status, p.reject_reason, p.progress, p.publisher_id, p.accepted_team_id, p.application_count, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.version, u.nickname AS publisher_name FROM project p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE p.status = 'published' ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.application_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
